s2.ptxt: Spray water on the door glass to wash off mud and dirt.
After spraying water on the door glass with a car wash hose or equivalent, check that water is repelled over the entire surface of the door glass and forms small beads.

atten4.ptxt: Perform the inspection by comparing the left and right sides or by comparing with a normal vehicle such as a new vehicle.

item.ptxt: If the entire door glass has poor water repellency, treat the entire surface. If the poor area is partial, treat only the poor area.
Do not allow the oil film remover, glass coating agent or finishing agent to adhere to painted surfaces, rubber or resin parts. If any adheres, wash it off with water immediately.

s3.ptxt: Spray water on the door glass and clean mud and dirt from the glass surface and surrounding weatherstrip with a shop rag.
Remove moisture with a shop rag or by air blowing.
Protect the weatherstrip with masking tape.
Shake the oil film remover to mix it thoroughly.
Apply oil film remover to a shop rag moistened with a small amount of water and polish the glass surface lightly.

item.ptxt: When the glass surface no longer repels the oil film remover, stop polishing.
Be careful, as excessive polishing will remove the remaining water repellent film.

s3.ptxt: Spray water on the door glass and wash off the oil film remover with a shop rag.
Thoroughly remove moisture with a shop rag or by air blowing.
Check that the glass surface is dry.

item.ptxt: Do not work in a location exposed to rain or water.
If moisture remains, unevenness will occur after applying the coating agent.

s3.ptxt: Apply a small amount of coating agent to a dry shop rag or tissue paper and apply it in a circular motion.
Leave it for 2 minutes or more, and apply again in the same way.

atten4.ptxt: The coating agent may remain white on the glass surface, but this does not affect performance.

s3.ptxt: Apply a small amount of finishing agent to a dry shop rag or tissue paper and apply it to the glass surface. Also wipe off any areas where the coating agent remains white with the finishing agent.
After it dries, spray water on the door glass and check the water repellent effect.

atten4.ptxt: The durability of the water repellent effect after treatment is approximately 1/3 that of a new water repellent door glass.

s3.ptxt: Remove the masking tape and wash the weatherstrip with water.
